title: GPU-driven draw: compute-written indirect arguments and instance data are covered only by a shader-storage barrier
expected_finding: gpu_cull writes indirect_buffer and instance_buffer; the barrier after the dispatch (glMemoryBarrier(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BARRIER_BIT) ported) has destination scope shader stages / SHADER_STORAGE_READ only, so vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect's INDIRECT_COMMAND_READ of indirect_buffer (DRAW_INDIRECT) and the VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_READ of instance_buffer (per-instance stream) are not ordered after the compute writes (read-after-write)
